props.command: I'm a teacher — where do I even start?
output: start with one recipe, this week
free for verified US K-12 — no barrier to entry

props.heading: not a deficit
props.body: AI didn't exist when you were in school. Nobody who started teaching before 2020 learned this. That's a date, not a personal failing.

props.heading: what the research says
props.body: RAND 2026 found that when EdTech worked, it was because teachers were trained — not because the platform was better. You are the variable.
props.evidenceNote: RAND 2026 — teacher training made or broke EdTech interventions

props.heading: the access question
props.body: Free for verified US K-12 teachers. FERPA data processing agreement. Your data never trains the model. No cost barrier. No data risk.
props.evidenceNote: Anthropic Claude for Teachers · Jul 14 2026 · FERPA DPA · data not trained
